analysis.intent_details: Notification about new job matches on Guru.com platform

responses.subject: Re: New Job Matches!
responses.body:
Dear Guru.com Team,

Thank you for the notification regarding new job matches. I appreciate you keeping me informed about relevant opportunities on your platform.

Please continue to send updates about suitable projects that align with my profile and expertise.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
responses.rationale: A professional acknowledgment is appropriate for this informational email. The sender is simply notifying about new job matches, which requires no action but warrants a polite response to maintain professional communication.

responses.subject: Acknowledgement: New Job Matches Notification
responses.body:
To Whom It May Concern,

This is to acknowledge receipt of your email dated February 15, 2026 regarding new job matches available through your platform. I have noted the information provided and will review the opportunities at my earliest convenience.

Please continue to forward relevant notifications as they become available.

Yours faithfully,
[Your Name]
responses.rationale: A formal acknowledgment is suitable for a business communication from a professional platform. This response confirms receipt while maintaining appropriate professional distance and formality.

responses.subject: Job Matches Notification - Received
responses.body:
Hello,

Thank you for the notification about new job matches on Guru.com. I've received your email and will review the opportunities you've identified.

I appreciate your platform's efforts to connect freelancers with relevant projects.

Best,
[Your Name]
responses.rationale: A concise professional response acknowledges the informational email without being overly formal. This strikes the right balance for a routine notification from a business platform where no specific action is required.
